junction.name: 5th Street & Cyril Magnin Street, San Francisco

claims.text: 5th Street & Cyril Magnin Street had 0 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 0 people killed.
These counts are 5th Street & Cyril Magnin Street's own: the city's record places 47 of the 47 records within 100 m at another intersection or street, and they are left out.
No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations (too few crashes to test).

This corner got continental crosswalks in 2015. Across the city: at 780 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (+4%, 95% interval -25% to +33%) could be zero. The city's own record neither shows it worked nor rules it out, so repeating it here rests on other evidence.
The city's painted safety zones: not shown (at 96 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (+2%, 95% interval -20% to +34%) could be zero); a second run of the same design on 780 sites agrees.

The San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency (SFMTA) is responsible for 5th Street, Cyril Magnin Street, Eddy Street, Market Street, Stevenson Street, Turk Street (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
A request letter to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency (SFMTA) is ready to draft from these facts.
